title: cp3 package.json
description: The cp3 project manifest read by cp3c (src/cli package_json.cpp). Other package.json fields are ignored by cp3c, so they are allowed but undocumented here.

name.description: Package name (falls back to the directory name).

type.description: "package" marks a publishable package (cp3 publish); "application" is a runnable project.

typeSystem.description: The project's type-name vocabulary: "rust"/"cpp" enable the plain native value-type spellings (i64, u64, ...); "typescript" is the default.

strictNumericCasts.description: Reject implicit numeric mixing at checked conversion points.

scripts.description: Runnable package scripts (`cp3c <script>`); the standard develop/compile/start/verify set is created by `cp3c init`.

bundleNativeDlls.description: Bundle native DLLs next to the executable (default true).
